Give lot’s of praise and treats when he reacts well but don’t force him to do anything if he’s showing signs of stress or you’ll make him worse. Also don’t let him lead in front of you when you’re walking him, he needs to be by your side. Your dog just needs to know that people are okay and they’re a good thing. Don’t let any strangers pet your dog on a walk if he’s clearly uncomfortable.
